name: neorgon-forge
description: Twenty-six skills arranged by where in the work you are: before/ (forge, docket, wayfind, untangle, grill, atlas, pathfinder), during/ (task, wizard, handoff, repitch, secret-safe-reporting), after/ (debrief, writeup, deckcraft, closeout), craft/ (penname, voicecheck, groundwork, quizmaster, mascot-forge, brandmark, sigil, tabletop, runcible-book, rappel-deck). Start at /forge, which routes over the rest and resolves the overlaps.

plugins.name: neorgon-forge
plugins.description: Twenty-six skills for finding your way into hard work, taking it on, then explaining it. The buckets are arc position, not topic, so the layout tells you when to reach for something rather than what department it belongs to. /forge is the router, and /docket answers the question that opens most sessions: what should I do now. The main flow is wayfind, grill, task, then debrief or writeup, with closeout to land what is left. Underneath all of them is .forge/: a brief written while the work happens, a glossary, a map, so the account of the work afterwards is a record rather than a recollection.
